about_the_game:
A Mini Auto Pachinko Machine on Your Desktop

This game is a quiet pachinko simulator that runs in a corner of your desktop.
Whether you're working, gaming, or just browsing — the pachinko never stops.

Launch marbles and aim for consecutive hits in the score box.
Watch as the colors intensify, effects stack up, and a satisfying reward loop unfolds.

Both auto-firing and manual control are available, letting you enjoy the idle income while still feeling the thrill of shooting marbles yourself.

Spend your hard-earned coins on various upgrades — unlock new marbles, enhance your launcher, get higher-paying part-time jobs, and unlock new machines.

Upgrade your very own pachinko life!

Features

  • A pachinko machine that runs while you work

  • 3 different machine themes

  • 8 types of marbles to please your eyes

  • Background music to delight your ears

Gameplay

  • Marbles won from the pachinko machine can be exchanged for in-game credits, which can be used to purchase themes, marbles, and upgrades!

  • Change the theme, marbles, and music to create your desired atmosphere!

  • If you feel unlucky, upgrade your launcher’s performance.

  • Out of marbles? You can convert credits back into marbles! By default, this happens automatically.

  • Even if you're not good at pachinko, you can still earn well through effort. Upgrade your job to increase your credit income!

⚠️ This game contains flashing lights and rapid visual effects that may trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy.

Viewer discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU recommended (GTX 750 or better)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
